examples.chinese: 這課的課文很有意思，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de kèwén hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: The text of this lesson is very interesting; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 我今天本來想去看電影，後來下雨就沒去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān běnlái xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, hòulái xià yǔ jiù méi qù le.
examples.english: Today I originally wanted to go see a movie, but later it rained so I didn't go.

examples.chinese: 我們在逛夜市的時候，忽然下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài guàng yèshì de shíhòu, hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.english: While we were strolling through the night market, it suddenly started to rain.

examples.chinese: 我討厭下雨，因為出去玩很不方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn xiàyǔ, yīnwèi chūqù wán hěn bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: I dislike rainy days because going out to have fun is very inconvenient.

examples.chinese: 雨停了，我們可以去公園野餐了。這座停車場很大，可以停五百輛汽車。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, wǒmen kěyǐ qù gōngyuán yěcān le. | Zhè zuò tíngchēchǎng hěn dà, kěyǐ tíng wǔbǎi liàng qìchē.
examples.english: The rain has stopped; we can go to the park for a picnic. | This parking lot is very big; it can park five hundred cars.

examples.chinese: 我們正在烤肉的時候，忽然下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài kǎo ròu de shíhou, hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.english: While we were having a barbecue, it suddenly started to rain.

examples.chinese: 這條公路很危險，一下大雨，山上的石頭就會掉下來。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn wēixiǎn, yī xià dà yǔ, shān shàng de shítou jiù huì diào xiàlái.
examples.english: This road is very dangerous; whenever it rains heavily, rocks from the mountain will fall down.

examples.chinese: 要不是下大雨，我們就去動物園玩了。
examples.pinyin: Yàobúshì xià dàyǔ, wǒmen jiù qù dòngwùyuán wán le.
examples.english: If it were not for the heavy rain, we would have gone to the zoo to have fun.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.
examples.english: Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 今明兩天的天氣可能從晴天轉雨天，出門前記得帶傘。
examples.pinyin: Jīn míng liǎng tiān de tiānqì kěnéng cóng qíngtiān zhuǎn yǔtiān, chūmén qián jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: The weather today and tomorrow may turn from sunny to rainy; remember to bring an umbrella before going out.

examples.chinese: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe dàyǔ, lù hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn kāichē.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside, the road is very slippery, please drive carefully.

examples.chinese: 窗外正下著大雨，我又沒帶傘，看來得在公司多留一會兒了。
examples.pinyin: Chuāngwài zhèng xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn, kànlái děi zài gōngsī duō liú yīhuìr le.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside the window, and I didn't bring an umbrella, so it seems that I'll have to stay at the office a while longer.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
examples.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

examples.chinese: 市長宣布明天因為颱風的風雨太大，不上班、不上課。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng xuānbù míngtiān yīnwèi táifēng de fēngyǔ tài dà, bù shàngbān, bù shàngkè.
examples.english: The mayor announced that tomorrow, because the typhoon's wind and rain are too strong, there will be no work and no school.

examples.chinese: 爬山時如果碰到大雨就應避免繼續前進，以免發生危險。
examples.pinyin: Páshān shí rúguǒ pèngdào dàyǔ jiù yīng bìmiǎn jìxù qiánjìn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: When mountain climbing, if you encounter heavy rain, you should avoid continuing to advance, so as to prevent danger from occurring.

examples.chinese: 下過雨後道路比較滑，開車時速度別太快。
examples.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ hòu dàolù bǐjiào huá, kāichē shí sùdù bié tài kuài.
examples.english: After it has rained, the road is rather slippery; when driving, don't go too fast.

examples.chinese: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān diànshìtái de qìxiàng bàogào shuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán yí dàzǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.english: Yesterday the TV station's weather report said it would rain today, and just as expected, it started raining early in the morning.

items.wordHook: 一(one) 冂(frame) holds 丷(horns) and 八(eight) drops → the pouring 雨(rain).

examples.chinese: 來台灣學中文以前，我把一些舊書丟了。聽說你的車子丟了。是在哪裡丟的？
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén yǐqián, wǒ bǎ yīxiē jiù shū diū le. Tīngshuō nǐ de chēzi diū le. Shì zài nǎlǐ diū de?
examples.english: Before coming to Taiwan to study Chinese, I threw away some old books. I heard your car was lost. Where was it lost?

examples.chinese: 那位客人的錢包丟了，非常著急。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén de qiánbāo diū le, fēicháng zháojí.
examples.english: That customer's wallet was lost, and he is very anxious.

examples.chinese: 你要把這些小說都丟了？太可惜了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào bǎ zhèxiē xiǎoshuō dōu diū le? Tài kěxī le!
examples.english: You're going to throw away all these novels? What a pity!

examples.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese:
我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。
A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá.
A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english:
I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately.
A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese:
我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。
A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le.
A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english:
I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 公司交給你的支票記得要收好，別弄丟了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāo gěi nǐ de zhīpiào jìde yào shōu hǎo, bié nòngdiū le.
examples.english: Remember to put away the check the company gave you properly; don't lose it.

examples.chinese: 到國外旅遊時身上別攜帶太多鈔票，否則錢丟了就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài lǚyóu shí shēnshang bié xiédài tài duō chāopiào, fǒuzé qián diū le jiù máfan le.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, don't carry too many banknotes on you; otherwise, if the money is lost, it will be troublesome.

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
examples.pinyin: Yòng guò yī miàn de zhǐzhāng bié jízhe diū, lìng yī miàn yě kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: Don't rush to throw away paper that has been used on one side; the other side can also be used.

examples.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
examples.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
examples.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

examples.chinese: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
examples.pinyin: Jiēdài kèhù shì yǒu jìqiǎo de, nòng bù hǎo kěnéng huì diū le shēngyì.
examples.english: Receiving clients requires skill; if you don't handle it well, you might lose the business.

examples.chinese: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dānxīn nòngdiū zhòngyào de zīliào, kě fùzhì yī fèn cún zài diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: If you are worried about losing important data, you can make a copy and save it on the computer.

examples.chinese: 住在這裡很安全，你不用擔心。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài zhèlǐ hěn ānquán, nǐ bùyòng dānxīn.
examples.english: Living here is very safe; you don't need to worry.

examples.chinese: 我可以自己回家，你不用陪我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zìjǐ huí jiā, nǐ bùyòng péi wǒ.
examples.english: I can go home by myself; you don't need to accompany me.

examples.chinese: 這個社區很安全，不用擔心小偷來偷東西。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, búyòng dānxīn xiǎotōu lái tōu dōngxi.
examples.english: This community is very safe; you don't need to worry about thieves coming to steal things.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese:
張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。
姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le.
Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard.
Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。在開心消費前應先想想，那些商品是不是需要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dōngxī mǎi huí jiā hòu cháng bǎi zhe bù yòng, nàyàng de xiāofèi jiù shì bù bìyào de. Zài kāixīn xiāofèi qián yīng xiān xiǎngxiang, nàxiē shāngpǐn shì bu shì xūyào de.
examples.english: If things are often left unused after being bought and brought home, that kind of consumption is unnecessary. Before happily consuming, you should first think about whether those products are needed.

examples.chinese: 我父親是保險公司的經理，要管理很多員工。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, yào guǎnlǐ hěn duō yuángōng.
examples.english: My father is a manager at an insurance company and has to manage many employees.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 張經理不但常加班，還要做市場研究，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ bùdàn cháng jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, měitiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Manager Zhang not only often works overtime but also has to do market research; every day he is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 下個星期我要和經理一起到美國去出差。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào hé jīnglǐ yìqǐ dào Měiguó qù chūchāi.
examples.english: Next week I will go to the US on a business trip together with the manager.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese:
經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。
小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin:
Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo.
Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english:
The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well.
Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese:
東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。
我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin:
Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng.
Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english:
Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance.
My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese:
那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。
經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin:
Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi.
Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english:
What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands.
The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese:
那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。
聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin:
Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào.
Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english:
That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me.
I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese:
我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。
經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī.
Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english:
My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of.
The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese:
許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。
你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin:
Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn.
Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english:
Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient.
There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese:
學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。
聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin:
Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí.
Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english:
Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria.
Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese:
想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。
算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。
明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí.
Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le.
Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english:
Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling.
Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires.
Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
examples.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

examples.chinese: 這家公司的工作條件和待遇都不錯，吸引不少年輕人來面試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gōngzuò tiáojiàn hé dàiyù dōu bùcuò, xīyǐn bùshǎo niánqīngrén lái miànshì.
examples.english: This company's working conditions and pay are both good, attracting many young people to come for interviews.

examples.chinese: 好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo cāntīng de dì yī tiáojiàn jiùshì bǎochí gānjìng, ràng kèrén yǒu shūshì de huánjìng.
examples.english: The first condition for a good restaurant is to keep it clean, so that customers have a comfortable environment.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cáinéng fúhé wǒmen gōngsī de tiáojiàn, shì wǒmen xūyào de réncái.
examples.english: Your talent matches our company's requirements; you are the talent we need.

examples.chinese: 想當節目主持人，具有好口才是最基本的條件。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dāng jiémù zhǔchírén, jùyǒu hǎo kǒucái shì zuì jīběn de tiáojiàn.
examples.english: If you want to be a program host, having good eloquence is the most basic requirement.

examples.chinese: 他因為生活條件的限制，而放棄了出國留學的機會。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēnghuó tiáojiàn de xiànzhì, ér fàngqì le chūguó liúxué de jīhuì.
examples.english: Due to limitations in his living conditions, he gave up the opportunity to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 表情豐富、能模仿不同人物，是演員應有的基本條件。
examples.pinyin: Biǎoqíng fēngfù, néng mófǎng bùtóng rénwù, shì yǎnyuán yīng yǒu de jīběn tiáojiàn.
examples.english: Having rich facial expressions and being able to imitate different characters are basic requirements for an actor.

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, "lóng" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn "lóng" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.
examples.english: In Chinese society, the "dragon" has important cultural significance, but the "dragon" actually does not exist.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì zīxùn hěn fādá, yī fāshēng zhòngyào shìqíng, lìkè jiù shàng diànshì, shàng bào le.
examples.english: In modern society, information is very developed; as soon as an important event happens, it immediately appears on TV and in the newspapers.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，見面時晚輩先問候長輩是應有的禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, jiànmiàn shí wǎnbèi xiān wènhòu zhǎngbèi shì yīngyǒu de lǐmào.
examples.english: In Chinese society, when meeting, it is proper etiquette for the younger generation to greet the elders first.

examples.chinese: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu hěn gāo de xuéwèi, zhǐyào yòngxīn yīyàng néng duì guójiā shèhuì yǒu gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Even without a high academic degree, as long as you are dedicated, you can still contribute to the country and society.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，農曆七月是拜祖先的月份。
examples.pinyin: Zài huárén shèhuì zhōng, nónglì qīyuè shì bài zǔxiān de yuèfèn.
examples.english: In Chinese societies, the seventh month of the lunar calendar is the month for worshipping ancestors.

examples.chinese: 華人社會中有很多重要的節日，比方(說)中秋節、農曆新年等等。
examples.pinyin: Huárén shèhuì zhōng yǒu hěnduō zhòngyào de jiérì, bǐfāng (shuō) Zhōngqiū Jié, Nónglì Xīnnián děngděng.
examples.english: In Chinese society, there are many important festivals, for instance, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Lunar New Year, and so on.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
examples.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.

items.wordHook: Combining 社(group) and 會(meet): 社會 means society.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

items.wordHook: Combining 發(distribute) and 覺(conscious): 發覺 means come to know.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 部分國家規定，騎腳踏車時是不能載人的。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn guójiā guīdìng, qí jiǎotàchē shí shì bù néng zài rén de.
examples.english: Some countries stipulate that when riding a bicycle, you cannot carry passengers.

examples.chinese: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng túshūguǎn jiè de shūjí yàoshi chāoguò guīdìng de shíjiān méi huán, kěshì yào fá qián de.
examples.english: If books borrowed from the library are not returned within the stipulated time, you will indeed be fined money.

examples.chinese: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng měi liǎng zhōu zhìshǎo cānjiā yí cì fúwù xuéxí huódòng.
examples.english: This school requires students to participate in at least one service-learning activity every two weeks.

examples.chinese: 根據規定，每位旅客只能攜帶一件七公斤以下的行李上飛機。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù guīdìng, měi wèi lǚkè zhǐ néng xiédài yí jiàn qī gōngjīn yǐxià de xíngli shàng fēijī.
examples.english: According to regulations, each traveler can only carry one piece of luggage under seven kilograms onto the plane.

examples.chinese: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
examples.pinyin: Bānjī qǐfēi qián, fúwù rényuán dōu huì wèi lǚkè shuōmíng yīng zhùyì de ānquán guīdìng.
examples.english: Before the flight takes off, the service staff will explain the safety regulations that should be noted to the passengers.

examples.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
examples.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的規定一條又一條的，看得我眼睛都累了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de guīdìng yī tiáo yòu yī tiáo de, kàn de wǒ yǎnjing dōu lèi le.
examples.english: This hospital's regulations are one article after another; reading them made my eyes tired.

examples.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
examples.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

examples.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
examples.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiǎoxué jiàodǎo háizi cóng píngcháng shēnghuó zhōng xuéxí zūnshǒu guīdìng.
examples.english: Elementary schools in Taiwan teach children to learn to comply with rules in their daily lives.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

examples.chinese: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lái le wèi xīn tóngshì, lǎobǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yīyī jièshào gōngsī de guīdìng.
examples.english: A new colleague came to the company, and the boss asked me to introduce the company's rules to him one by one.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 公司全體都支持昨天公告的那條規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī quántǐ dōu zhīchí zuótiān gōnggào de nà tiáo guīdìng.
examples.english: The entire company supports the regulation announced yesterday.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

examples.chinese: 裁判的工作是確定每位選手都遵守規定，讓比賽順利進行。
examples.pinyin: Cáipàn de gōngzuò shì quèdìng měi wèi xuǎnshǒu dōu zūnshǒu guīdìng, ràng bǐsài shùnlì jìnxíng.
examples.english: The referee's job is to make sure every athlete follows the rules, so that the competition runs smoothly.

examples.chinese: 文化中心跟大學合辦了一場音樂會，吸引不少民眾參加。
examples.pinyin: Wénhuà zhōngxīn gēn dàxué hé bàn le yī chǎng yīnyuèhuì, xīyǐn bùshǎo mínzhòng cānjiā.
examples.english: The cultural center and the university jointly held a concert, attracting many people to attend.

examples.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gēn kǎtōng rénwù yǒuguān de shūjí, hěn shìhé értóng yuèdú.
examples.english: These books related to cartoon characters are very suitable for children to read.

examples.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese:
這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。
因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin:
Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo.
Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english:
This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good.
Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese:
我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。
除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo.
Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english:
Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags.
On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese:
這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。
老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān.
Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english:
This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting.
The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.
examples.english: The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people.

examples.chinese: 買襯衫的時候得注意肩膀的大小，太大或太小都不合適。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi chènshān de shíhou děi zhùyì jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo, tài dà huò tài xiǎo dōu bù héshì.
examples.english: When buying a shirt, you need to pay attention to the size of the shoulders; too big or too small are both unsuitable.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 我點的這首歌很簡單，我們一起合唱吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ diǎn de zhè shǒu gē hěn jiǎndān, wǒmen yìqǐ héchàng ba!
examples.english: This song I requested is very simple; let's sing it together!

examples.chinese: 合歡山山上的空氣很好，風景也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Héhuān Shān shān shàng de kōngqì hěn hǎo, fēngjǐng yě bùcuò.
examples.english: The air on Hehuan Mountain is very good, and the scenery is not bad either.

examples.chinese: 春天是花開的季節，在愛情故事中，往往也是適合戀愛的季節。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān shì huā kāi de jìjié, zài àiqíng gùshì zhōng, wǎngwǎng yě shì shìhé liàn'ài de jìjié.
examples.english: Spring is the season when flowers blossom; in love stories, it is often also the season suitable for falling in love.

examples.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
examples.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

examples.chinese: 這場大型戶外活動因為租不到合適的地方，就被取消了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàxíng hùwài huódòng yīnwèi zū bú dào héshì de dìfāng, jiù bèi qǔxiāo le.
examples.english: This large outdoor event was canceled because a suitable place couldn't be rented.

examples.chinese: 今天海邊的浪不大，不適合去衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān hǎibiān de làng bú dà, bú shìhé qù chōnglàng.
examples.english: The waves at the beach are not big today, so it's not suitable to go surfing.

examples.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
examples.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

examples.chinese: 這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juésè yīzhí zhǎo bù dào héshì de yǎnyuán, xìngkuī nà wèi míngxīng diǎntóu dāyìng yǎnchū, fǒuzé yǐngpiàn jiù pāi bù chéng le.
examples.english: They couldn't find a suitable actor for this role all along; fortunately, that celebrity nodded and agreed to perform, otherwise the film couldn't have been made.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒngyǒu yī duàn bǎiniánhǎohé de hūnyīn, chúle zhēnxīn de àiqíng zhīwài, yě yīng zhòngshì jiātíng de zérèn.
examples.english: If you want to have a marriage that is a harmonious union forever, in addition to genuine love, you should also value family responsibility.

examples.chinese: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cáinéng fúhé wǒmen gōngsī de tiáojiàn, shì wǒmen xūyào de réncái.
examples.english: Your talent matches our company's requirements; you are the talent we need.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

examples.chinese: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
examples.pinyin: Zài quánqiú huánjìng huìyì zhōng, Liánhéguó yāoqǐng le yìxiē huánbǎo tuántǐ gòngtóng cānyù.
examples.english: At the global environmental conference, the United Nations invited some environmental groups to participate together.

examples.chinese: 團體活動中，不團結就失去了合作的意義。
examples.pinyin: Tuántǐ huódòng zhōng, bù tuánjié jiù shīqù le hézuò de yìyì.
examples.english: In group activities, if there is no unity, then the meaning of cooperation is lost.

items.wordHook: a 亼(gather) of hands covers a 口(mouth) → one team, 合(join).

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們要去騎腳踏車／自行車。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yào qù qí jiǎotàchē/zìxíngchē.
examples.english: This weekend we are going to ride bikes.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

items.wordHook: a 口(mouth) shouts 止(stop) at a 沓(pad) of feet → 踏(trample).

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

items.wordHook: A weary traveler 亻(person) pauses under a roadside 亭(pavilion) to rest: 停(suspend).
護(protect) + 理(care) + 師(professional) → a professional who protects and cares for patients: nurse.
